statement: Every test in the census carries exactly one deterministically derived subsystem classification, sealed by a census-and-digest manifest whose --check mode fails when any test is unclassified, misclassified against its derivation, or lost; CI selection behaviour is unchanged by this Quest.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The subsystem manifest census must equal the primary/resource census exactly. A test may never be dropped, silently defaulted, or double-counted by classification.

Every subsystem value must be derived from repository-declared state by a pure function of the test path and the declared owner boundaries, never from timing, filesystem contents outside the repository, or manual per-test edits that the deriver cannot reproduce.
This Quest adds classification only. No gate, manifest, or npm script may change which tests CI selects; the required check must run the same corpus before and after.

A test the deriver cannot classify must fail the --check mode by name. Assigning an unmatched test to a catch-all subsystem is forbidden, because silent under-classification is indistinguishable from correct classification.

legacy.title: seal a subsystem classification over every test in the census
